options.name: axfr_ips
options.description: The list of IPs that may perform a zone transfer for this Domain.

options.name: description
options.description: The list of IPs that may perform a zone transfer for this Domain.

options.name: expire_sec
options.description: The amount of time in seconds that may pass before this Domain is no longer authoritative.

options.name: master_ips
options.description: The IP addresses representing the master DNS for this Domain.

options.name: refresh_sec
options.description: The amount of time in seconds before this Domain should be refreshed.

options.name: retry_sec
options.description: The interval, in seconds, at which a failed refresh should be retried.

options.name: soa_email
options.description: The Start of Authority email address.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the target.

options.name: status
options.description: Used to control whether this Domain is currently being rendered.

options.name: tags
options.description: An array of tags applied to this object.

options.name: ttl_sec
options.description: The amount of time in seconds that this Domain’s records may be cached by resolvers or other domain servers.

options.name: type
options.description: Whether this Domain represents the authoritative source of information for the domain it describes (master), or whether it is a read-only copy of a master (slave).
